name: Smart Nanchong / Nanchong computing center projects
developer: Nanchong Municipal Data Bureau / local partners
notes: Municipal data bureau budget/work notices refer to accelerating Smart Nanchong and computing-center key projects, including 智算中心(南充) and supporting Peng'an intelligent computing center备案/开工. MW not disclosed.

name: Nanchong existing data centers / Northeast Sichuan edge big data center
developer: Nanchong local government / telecom operators
notes: Nanchong government materials say the city has the largest internet data center and big-data cloud-computing center in northeast Sichuan; a 2023 city industry bureau item says the 川东北边缘大数据中心 had been completed and included as a national new-type data-center typical case. MW not disclosed.

name: Neijiang Big Data Center / Neijiang Unicom Southern Sichuan Information Hub
developer: Neijiang municipal agencies / China Unicom Neijiang
notes: Neijiang economic-information budget materials list 内江大数据中心 and 内江联通川南信息枢纽 among smart-city priority projects. Later public confirmation of facility scale/status was not found in this pass; MW not disclosed.

name: Panzhihua Specialty Industry Big Data Center
developer: Panzhihua Vanadium-Titanium High-Tech Zone / Panzhihua municipal government
notes: Municipal planning PDF describes a Southwest/滇西北 characteristic big-data center with IDC rooms, network core data center, cloud-computing operations center and application innovation facilities; Sichuan Online reported a planned 136-mu Panzhihua specialty-industry big data center. MW not disclosed.

name: Panzhihua Smart City Operations Center / Big Data Center
developer: Panzhihua municipal government / Inspur and partners
notes: Inspur case study states the Panzhihua smart-city operations center launched on 2020-10-15 and integrates municipal data/video resources; district government materials note the Panzhihua big data center and smart-city operations management center are operating. MW not disclosed.

name: Suining Smart Center / e-government cloud and big data center
developer: Suining Digital City Technology Co. / China Electronics System Technology
notes: Suining planning says the city has built its first intelligent computing center, with 557 racks, 335P general compute and 543P intelligent compute, while earlier government replies identify China Electronics-backed Suining Digital City and a 0.9bn yuan Smart Suining cloud platform/big data center. MW not disclosed.

name: China Ya'an Big Data Industrial Park / China Ya Cloud Digital Technology City
developer: Ya'an Economic Development Zone / Ya'an municipal government / park operators
notes: Official Ya'an pages describe the park as opened in 2019, with data-room infrastructure above 23 ha/230,000 m2 and rack scale reaching 30,000; earlier materials cite 4 five-star data-center buildings, 150,000+ m2 data rooms and 20,000 racks. Tenants include Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance and others. MW not disclosed.

name: China Ya Cloud Artificial Intelligence Computing Industry Project / Ya Cloud Intelligent Computing Center
developer: Ya'an Economic Development Zone / China Construction Third Engineering Bureau / Ya'an state-owned partners
notes: Official releases describe a 7.5bn yuan AI compute-industry project with intelligent computing center buildings, science/innovation buildings, substations and smart-park systems; a later public-procurement/project item puts 中国雅云智算中心 at about 109.46 mu and 1.022bn yuan for three computing-center buildings. MW not disclosed.

name: Shutian Chaoyun Data Center Project
developer: Shutian Chaoyun / Ya'an state-owned digital company
notes: Ya'an SASAC page says the project includes about 5,800 big-data standard cabinets and compute-center systems including CPU/GPU resource pools, network, security, storage, virtualization, cloud management and compute scheduling. MW not disclosed.

name: Shuju Chengbao Yibin Intelligent Computing Center at Yangtze River Upper Reaches Regional Big Data Center
developer: Shuju Chengbao / Yibin local partners
notes: Yibin government says the city's first intelligent computing center lit up at the Yangtze River Upper Reaches Regional Big Data Center on 2025-04-18. The broader big-data center is planned at about 250,000 m2 and 3bn yuan; phase 1 about 100,000 m2, 1,250 cabinets. The intelligent-compute project totals 0.8bn yuan over three phases, at least 4,000P total and 1,000P in phase 1. MW not disclosed.

name: Zigong Smart City Big Data Center
developer: Zigong municipal smart-city project / China Telecom partners
notes: EAST UPS vendor case study says it supplied HVDC power and precision-airflow server-cabinet solutions for the Zigong smart-city big data center construction project with China Telecom-related smart city work. Public rack/MW figures not found.

name: Ziyang Tianfu (Huawei) Cloud Computing Center
developer: Ziyang municipal government / Huawei
notes: Sichuan Daily-sourced report says Ziyang Tianfu (Huawei) Cloud Computing Center went online on 2017-08-18, initially with 71 transitional racks, 27 in operation and 21 application systems online; Ziyang High-Tech Zone was building a permanent machine room with 1,000 racks planned for 2019. MW not disclosed.

name: Tencent Tianjin High-Tech Cloud Data Center
developer: Tencent
notes: Tencent's north China hyperscale data center in Tianjin High-Tech Zone/Bolong Lake Science Park was officially enabled in 2022; reported total investment is 10bn yuan, 15,000 racks and 300,000-server capacity. Tencent later announced a 10.54MW distributed solar microgrid at the data center, but IT load MW was not disclosed.

name: GDS / 21Vianet? Sinnet Tianjin Baodi Cloud Computing Base Phase I
developer: Beijing Sinnet Technology Co. / Sinnet Tianjin Information Service
notes: Listed-company feasibility report for 天津宝坻云计算基地一期 says the Baodi Economic Development Zone project would build two standard cloud-computing-center buildings and support facilities with about 5,000 5kW 2N standard cabinets. Capacity_mw calculated from 5,000 x 5kW cabinet design, not directly stated as total IT load.

name: China Telecom Jing-Jin-Ji Big Data Base
developer: China Telecom Group
notes: Huawei/XD design case page locates China Telecom's Jing-Jin-Ji Big Data Base in Tianjin Wuqing, with 164,415.2 m2 land, twelve data-center buildings totaling 312,700 m2, three power centers totaling 31,000 m2 and related support buildings. MW not disclosed.

name: Tianjin Huayuan Unicom Data Port Data Center
developer: China Unicom Tianjin / IDC operator partners
notes: Commercial IDC listing for Tianjin Huayuan Unicom Data Port says the facility in Huayuan Industrial Park has 20,918 m2 and 2,800 racks at 3kVA/rack, opened July 2009. Capacity_mw approximates rack apparent power as 2,800 x 3kVA; exact IT MW not disclosed. Vertiv case separately documents a Tianjin Unicom Airport Building 3 data center of 8,130 m2 with 8 IDC rooms.

name: Tianjin Wuqing China Telecom Data Center
developer: China Telecom Tianjin / IDC operator partners
notes: Commercial IDC listing says Tianjin Wuqing Telecom Data Center in Wuqing Economic Development Zone has 1,200 racks, 12,000 m2 and opened July 2010. Capacity_mw approximates 1,200 racks x 2.2kVA/rack; exact IT MW not disclosed.

name: Ningsuan Tibet Cloud Computing Data Center / Ningsuan Data Center Phase I
developer: Tibet Ningsuan Technology Group
notes: Tibet government and Tibet Daily sources describe the Lhasa High-Tech Zone project as Tibet's largest/highest-altitude cloud-computing data center: 645,000 m2 site, 400,000 m2 green new-generation data center, 11.8bn yuan over three phases, 70,000 cabinets at full buildout. Phase I was completed/accepted on 2020-12-18; phase I stage 2 had begun in 2020 with 10,000 racks expected after phase I. MW not disclosed.

name: China Mobile Tibet Lhasa Data Center
developer: China Mobile Tibet
notes: County-government repost says China Mobile (Tibet Lhasa) Data Center phase I electromechanical works were completed and put into operation. The Lhasa High-Tech Zone key project had total investment of 739m yuan, 63 mu site, 51,405 m2 building area and 6,600 designed server cabinets, built to high national standards for IDC + cloud services. MW not disclosed.

name: National Tibetan Plateau Data Center Tibet Branch
developer: Tibet Autonomous Region Science and Technology Department / Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research, CAS / Tibet Ningsuan Technology Group
notes: Tibet government says the National Tibetan Plateau Data Center Tibet Branch was launched in Lhasa, jointly built by the regional science-and-technology department, CAS Institute of Tibetan Plateau Research, and Tibet Ningsuan Technology Group. Research/scientific data center; MW not disclosed.
